name: echo mind blown
description: Proposal, the mind blown gesture (no words, no one's art), 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x, low in the panel to leave the top free): the creature rests and blinks, its eyes go wide with an antenna ping, both hands come up to its temples and its head trembles, the top of its head with the antenna lifts off with white and gold light pouring out of the gap, then breaks into its own 2 x 2 pixels that spray up and out in a fan inside a ring of sparks while its hands fling wide, the pixels hang a beat while sparks rise from the open head, then rain back along their lines and click home with a flash of ping light at the seam, the hands come down, a blink and a happy daze; judge whether the gesture reads at a glance, whether the spray reads as the head's own pixels and the rain as them coming home, and whether it is still this creature.
